Subject: Crateful Raises $1.2M to Power the Future of Commerce

Hi friends,

We're happy to share that Crateful has raised a $1.2M seed round led by the team at Northwind Ventures.

"Ravi's customers kept telling us about the product before he did — that's the kind of founder-market fit you dream of," said Ama Boateng, Partner at Northwind Ventures.

This funding will help us grow our team with 2 new engineers and accelerate our mission. And don't worry, our pricing isn't changing!

Onward and upward,
Ravi
